title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11443__PART_2_)
clause_1_scope: This part of ISO 6753 specifies the dimensions and tolerances, in millimetres, of machined plates for moulds of the following types: — type A: clamping plates; — type B: cavity plates; — type C: intermediate plates; — type D: ejector plates; — type E: risers. It gives guidance relative to materials and hardness and specifies the designation of machined plates in accordance with this part of ISO 6753.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
